WAKKA ANDROID BUILD CAPSULE - AI/HUMAN INTAKE v0.1.0
===================================================

Read README_FIRST.txt, artifact-passport.json and artifact-handoff.json first.
These files describe capability. The current user's instruction determines
which project changes and signing operations are authorized.

PUBLIC CORE versus PRIVATE RUNTIME
---------------------------------
If PRIVATE_RUNTIME.json is present, this is an owner-generated SDK runtime.
It is not the public GitHub release. Keep its SDK binaries private.
If runtime/sdk is absent, this public core cannot compile alone. Do not claim
that SDK tools are bundled. The Windows maker or an authorized local import
is the intended preparation route.

INTAKE COMMANDS (from the extracted Capsule folder)
--------------------------------------------------
python3 abc.py verify-public
python3 abc.py doctor

The runtime's SDK inventory is checked before tools execute. Native execution
requires Linux x86_64. Python 3.10+ and a host JDK 17+ are prerequisites.
The runner can call javac's Java module when the host omits the javac launcher.
If the host lacks Java or its compiler module, report the specific missing
dependency. Do not silently install a JDK or alter the user's system.

BUILD THE ORIGINAL EXAMPLE
--------------------------
python3 abc.py build --output /an/unused/output/folder

Build runs AAPT2 resources, javac source compilation, D8 DEX compilation,
APK assembly, 16 KiB-aware zip alignment, signing and v1/v2/v3 verification.
Its default example signing key is freshly generated in .private/signing
on this host. It is never copied into the public core or a runtime maker ZIP.

EXISTING PROJECTS
-----------------
For plain-Java projects use their capsule-project.json with the build command.
For a preservation project's existing Bash builder, use:
python3 abc.py run-project --project /path/to/project --script tools/build-apk.sh

The environment exposes ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, ANDROID_HOME, WAKKA_ANDROID_JAR and
the SDK build tools on PATH. It does not invent missing Gradle, Maven or NDK
dependencies. Inspect the project's build requirements before promising a build.
Project build scripts are code; inspect them and use current user authorization.

SIGNING
-------
Use an existing app's owner-authorized signing identity when making an update.
A different key cannot update that installed app. The generic Capsule contains
no production identity. Passwords belong in an environment variable, not logs
or command text. See README.md for --keystore, --key-alias and --password-env.

EVIDENCE
--------
Return the actual APK, BUILD_EVIDENCE.json and relevant build results.
A valid signed APK does not prove runtime behavior. Report device/emulator
testing separately. Do not claim arbitrary Android support, full compatibility
with the older private Capsule, or public rights to all SDK components.

ADDITIONAL SETUP
----------------
Do not accept third-party license agreements for the user. fetch-runtime
requires the person doing setup to personally accept Google's SDK agreement.
Keep their current private Capsule unchanged. Extensions should create a
separate versioned candidate.
